texts.desc: Add 1 "Zenet" monster from your Deck to your hand. If you discard a "Zenet" Ritual Monster(s) while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card; Special Summon 1 non-Effect Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with ATK less than or equal to any of the discarded monsters' as a Normal Monster Card, but for the rest of this turn, it cannot attack directly, also you cannot activate non-Zombie monster effects. You can only use each effect of "Zenet Per Akh" once per turn.
texts.name: Zenet Per Akh
texts.str3: Treat as a Normal Monster Card
